summary.core_finding: Stage A/D6 supports candidate-proposal and evidence-status diagnostics but does not test per-authored-group attribution fields or group profiles.
summary.input_contract: AuthoredGroup, analysis_scene_view, and group_self_description disagree on eligibility, empty groups, duplicate/dangling references, and shared-member identity.

runtime_reproduction.fixture_description: One generic all-furniture group, two explicit furniture groups sharing left_table, and one empty explicit furniture group.
runtime_reproduction.observation: Generic membership wins first-owner mapping in analysis_scene_view; group_self_description excludes the generic group while retaining both explicit memberships and the empty explicit group.

matrix.finding: Generic all-furniture groups qualify in analysis_scene_view but are excluded by group_self_description.
Empty explicit group handling differs; duplicate references lack a shared audit/deduplication contract.
Dangling members are invalid in group_self_description but not exposed consistently in analysis_scene_view; canonical contract rejects them.
Shared membership is retained in group_self_description but first-wins in analysis_scene_view.
No driver/modifier perturbation separates candidate changes from attribution changes.
Exact valid-endpoint candidate veto with unavailable geometry is supported; full attribution-field effects remain untested.
Dangling, ambiguous, and out-of-scope exclusion endpoints are not tested.
No membership attribution tests for unknown/conditional statuses or scalar-readout eligibility.
Bounded search exists as historical design evidence but lacks an explicit separate completeness state in target output.
No out-of-scope/uncovered attribution record semantics; scope exclusion is candidate-level only.
Proposal holdout analogues exist, but no attribution ablation/independent-evidence comparison.
Bridge-chain proposal fixture is not a member attribution profile; protocol arithmetic lacks a located frozen source fixture.
No expected/observed attribution evidence coverage denominator.
Singleton proposal diagnostics exist, but singleton/low-coverage attribution profiles do not.
Nested/overlapping proposals exist, but comparable member profiles do not.

next_design_work: Resolve the authored-group eligibility and identity contract.
Specify complete field domain and explicit absent-cell statuses.
Add design-only attribution fixtures for driver/modifier perturbation, invalid veto endpoints, proposal leakage, and member profiles.
Revise and review the non-probabilistic strength spec before any implementation plan.
limitations: The sibling Stage A checkout is dirty; its runner was not executed and its report is treated as historical evidence only.
No real-scene blind review or 37-node search-cost benchmark was performed.
No production score, scalar mapping, probability, or calibration claim was tested.
